stations.title: Odile
stations.say: Can it type like a person?
stations.note: In the chat window on her phone.

stations.title: Moss
stations.text: Writes a reply in small pieces.
stations.note: Each piece holds only what is new.

stations.title: Chat window
stations.text: Shows the reply as it grows.

captions: Moss fills in orders now. Odile tries the new chat window on her phone.
A customer asks about an orchid, and the bubble stays empty until it all lands.
You write the code that reads the stream, in three tasks.
Now the orchid answer appears word by word as Moss writes it.
Same answer, no blank wait. And a cut reply never passes as a whole one.
